steps.label: Intents Arrive
steps.description: Traders sign order intents — specifying token pair, limit price, and deadline — and post them to the off-chain order book. No transaction is broadcast yet. The signed intent is valid until the deadline; the solver will pick the execution path.
steps.detail: A sell order: 1 ETH → USDC, limit $1,720. A buy order: 3,450 USDC → ETH, limit $1,750. Both are live in the mempool.

steps.label: Batch Sealed
steps.description: Every 30 seconds the protocol seals the current set of intents into a batch. No new orders enter this batch; no solver can front-run individual trades because the full set is fixed before settlement begins.
steps.detail: Batch #4,812,091 sealed. 47 intents across 12 token pairs. Solvers now have ~10 seconds to find the optimal settlement.

steps.label: Solvers Compete
steps.description: Off-chain solver bots (Quasimodo, Naive, Paraswap, 0x, custom MEV searchers) each submit a proposed settlement path. They can route through AMMs, aggregators, or match intents directly against each other (Coincidence of Wants). The solver who generates the most surplus wins.
steps.detail: Winning solver: routes the ETH→USDC order directly against the USDC→ETH order (CoW), saving both traders LP fees. Clearing price: $1,735.

steps.label: Settlement Executes
steps.description: The winning solver submits one on-chain transaction to GPv2Settlement. The contract verifies all signatures, checks limit prices, applies the uniform clearing price across every matched trade, and transfers tokens atomically.
steps.detail: Tx: 0x9008…ab41. Gas: ~320,000 (shared across 47 trades). Each trader pays ~$0.004 gas equivalent — 12× cheaper than individual swaps.

steps.label: Surplus Distributed
steps.description: Any price improvement above each trader's stated limit price is their surplus. With the uniform clearing price at $1,735 and a limit of $1,720, the seller gets $15 extra per ETH back as surplus — not absorbed by LPs or the protocol.
steps.detail: Seller surplus: +$15 USDC. Buyer surplus: +$15 USDC equivalent. Solver fee: 0.05% of surplus. No LP fee on the CoW match.
